completeness.why: All five provider functions only map their own account fields and bank key and delegate the whole sequence (bank find-or-create, upgrade-or-insert with transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse, sync-event) to linkBankSyncAccount; the preserved inconsistencies are explicit arguments (mask only for GoCardless, syncFileId only for Pluggy.ai, syncEventTables ['transactions'] for Akahu), and the unreachable id == null check is dropped.

interface.why: Every parameter carries a real per-provider variation (sync source, bank key, institution, account fields, optional mask, optional file id, sync-event tables) with no speculative options, and each preserved inconsistency is visible as an explicit argument at its call site.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies of the link sequence were deleted; only per-provider field mapping remains at each site.
